description: This file declares internal functions for the Http Ato Status object within a broader HTTP implementation. It is a header file defining function prototypes related to creating status code and name tables, and retrieving atom codes and names.

methods.name: HttpAtoStatusCreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a table mapping status codes to internal representations.

methods.name: HttpAtoStatusCreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a table mapping status names to internal representations.

methods.name: HttpAtoStatusGetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the internal atom code for a given status name.

methods.name: HttpAtoStatusGetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the status name associated with a given atom code.
